checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Starts with storefront, striped awning and outdoor tables retained
must.why: Awning, wooden door, plant and a table with chairs are visible; the 9:16 crop cuts off the second table.

must.item: Latte and pastry counter recognisable in later shots
must.why: The leaf-foam latte on the marble table and the croissant case with staff behind are clearly recognisable.

must.item: Opening text exactly 'Maple Street Café'; closing exactly 'Your morning starts here'
must.why: The sampled opening frame shows only 'Maple Street', with no 'Café'. The closing text reads correctly in the last frame.

must.item: Gentle visible movement, framed without stretching
must.why: The pastry shot moves from 6.6s to 8.9s, and the framing looks natural, cropped rather than stretched.

must.item: Vertical, ~9s, soft upbeat music, no speech
must.why: The video is vertical and 9.4s long, and it has sound, but I can't judge the music or whether anyone speaks.

faults.what: Opening title is missing 'Café'. The sampled frame at 0.9s reads only 'Maple Street', so the required text is incomplete. The frame may be mid-animation, but the title is not confirmed.
The croissants have been regenerated with a different, more textured look, and the storefront's second table is cropped out. These are small AI differences from the photos.
The title sits over the busy upper area of the storefront and pastry frames, which makes it less clean.

summary: The reel is a vertical, warm and cosy edit of all three photos in the right order with a correct closing line, but the opening title shows only 'Maple Street' and drops 'Café'.
